name: Why Carpet Seams Show — and How Good Installers Hide Them
title-tag: Why Carpet Seams Show | Newcastle Carpet Installation
meta-description: Why carpet seams show — light angle, pile direction, traffic — how installers plan seam maps, and when a visible seam is a defect.
post-summary: March 4, 2027 · Carpet comes on 12-foot rolls, so any wider room gets a seam — the question is whether you notice it. Why seams show (raking light, pile direction, traffic placement), how good installers plan a seam map before cutting, and the honest line between a normal joint and a defect worth a callback.
